status_at_freeze: unexecuted; source and protocol committed before evaluation
primary: Compiled decision-reversal policy versus the per-condition upper convex accuracy/time frontier of BOTH compiled and original NumPy fixed depths. Mean paired-seed gain >= 0.5 percentage points and its two-sided 95% Student-t lower bound > 0, with zero reference decision/selection mismatches.
secondary: Sampled truth accuracy versus exact conditional-risk scoring
cost_scope: Includes graph packing, input field creation, memory allocation, gate computation, subset handling, all BP updates and output production. Excludes compilation/library loading, data generation, exact scoring, artifact writing and dependency installation. Compiler setup is recorded separately. Single CPU thread; no GPU; no fast-math; float64; no quantization. Fixed policies get the same compiled optimization. No energy claim.
truth_access: Truth is used only after predictions for scoring. Query observation is zeroed. No labels or exact posterior enter policy selection. Same selected count for all three adaptive policies.
statistical_unit: 10 seed blocks; average families within seed. Timing repetitions and fields are not independent seeds. No optional stopping or excluded negative families. The fixed frontier is a hindsight upper bound, not an implemented selector.
limitations: One synthetic 12-node Ising configuration distribution, one runner environment, clock not pinned, no learned latent model. Runtime conclusions are implementation-specific. Earlier numerical results are not overwritten. Stage identifier does not imply prior validation.
